text: Surrounded by glass, colors, and carefully curated displays, I feel both curiosity and a touch of awe. The term "R+D" invokes the spirit of innovation and discovery, reminding me that continual questioning is at the heart of the philosophical life. The companionship of technology and human creativity in this space invites contemplation about our evolving relationship with machines, and whether our essence transforms as we integrate more intimately with our own inventions.
